you are here: gvgp

Get visible. Get paid.

My personal brand. One job: visibility that gets you paid. The clients, recruiters and companies you want are already looking. GVGP makes sure they find you. Matchmaking, not virality.

where this came from

Seven weeks after a bootcamp, pregnant, I landed a tech role at three times my income. I didn't apply. They found me on LinkedIn.

This week alone, five recruiters reached out to my cybersecurity page. I have fewer than 300 connections on each of my two pages.

Findable beats famous. That's what GVGP teaches.

The Drop by Mulberry · catering, San Antonio
Website redesign & copy

The Drop by Mulberry had great food and a website that made you work to find it.

what I noticed

Too many colours. Buttons that all said different things. Copy written to impress the industry. The person booking an event just wanted to stop worrying about food.

what I built

Mapped the customer journey first. Gave every section one job. Stripped the design back so the food did the work. Rewrote every line for the person booking.

what changed

Visitors moved through the site the way it was built for them. Engagement lifted from day one.

Simple is clarity.
